dialogues.speaker: Kourosh
dialogues.text: Not really, but I'm used to it.

dialogues.speaker: Kourosh
dialogues.text: It's practice. Lessons from Mr. Sheikh Zubayr, then more practice. Rinse and repeat.

dialogues.speaker: Kourosh
dialogues.text: I thought about giving up, but then I remembered how, despite all his criticisms, Mr. Zubayr never told me to quit.

dialogues.speaker: Kourosh
dialogues.text: That means there's still hope for me, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kourosh
dialogues.text: But have I made any progress?
